{{Quote|You're worried about the Commission saving face among its IBC cronies and upholding your personnel reputation for being tough on corruption and organized crime all of which I respect. But I hardly think you need to threaten me with fines.|Warden Sadiki Blirr to Commissioner Dragomir Chlorus|<ref name="Maul: Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref>}}
The '''Galactic Gaming Commission''', also called the '''Gaming Authority''', was the organization governing the conduction of [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] activities.

[[Commissioner (Galactic Gaming Commission)|Commissioner]] [[Dragomir Chlorus]] worked for the Gaming Commission in the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was responsible for monitoring the gladiatorial fights between [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] set up by [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Sadiki Blirr]] at the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and that were funded by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].
